disclaimer: This is a reflection, not a diagnosis. It is a short self-report scale and a reading of your own words, and it can be wrong.

items.E1: Am the life of the party.
items.E7: Talk to a lot of different people at parties.
items.E8: Don't like to draw attention to myself.
items.E9: Don't mind being the center of attention.
items.A5: Am not interested in other people's problems.
items.A7: Am not really interested in others.
items.C6: Often forget to put things back in their proper place.
items.N2: Am relaxed most of the time.
items.O4: Am not interested in abstract ideas.
items.O6: Do not have a good imagination.

test.intro: Fifty short statements, one at a time. Answer how accurately each describes you as you are now, not as you would like to be. Your place is saved after every answer.
test.statementLabel: How accurately does this describe you?
test.retakeBody: You will answer all fifty questions again. Your last result stays saved, and the page will show it as "last time".
test.discardBody: The answers you have given in this sitting will be cleared.
test.savedHint: Saved on this device and synced with your account.

result.heading: Your portrait
result.trackAriaJournal: {{trait}}: you {{self}} out of 100, your journal {{journal}} out of 100.

openness.low: You tend to prefer the familiar and the practical.
openness.mid: You mix new ideas with what you already know.
openness.high: You are drawn to new ideas, art and experiences.

conscientiousness.low: You tend to keep plans loose and stay flexible.
conscientiousness.mid: You are organised in some places and relaxed in others.
conscientiousness.high: You like order, plans and following through.

extraversion.low: You tend to be quiet and recharge on your own.
extraversion.mid: You move between company and time to yourself.
extraversion.high: You tend to seek out people and feel energised by them.

agreeableness.low: You tend to say what you think, even when it is blunt.
agreeableness.mid: You balance being kind with standing your ground.
agreeableness.high: You tend to put people at ease and care how they feel.

neuroticism.low: You tend to stay steady when things get stressful.
neuroticism.mid: Stress affects you at times, and at times it does not.
neuroticism.high: You tend to feel stress and mood shifts strongly.

gap.close: Your journal and your answers agree on {{trait}}.
gap.journalHigher: Your journal reads as more {{adjective}} than you rated yourself.
gap.journalLower: Your journal reads as less {{adjective}} than you rated yourself.

journal.heading: What your journal reads as
journal.body: Separate from the test: your own AI reads your recent written days and scores them on the same five traits, so you can compare.
journal.notConnected: Connect an AI in Settings to read your journal. The test works without it.
journal.noDays: Write a few journal days first. Only days with a title or text can be read.
journal.needTest: Take the test first, then compare it with your journal.
journal.consentTitle: Send these days to your AI?
journal.consentBody_one: The words of {{count}} written day (title, date and the first 300 characters of the entry) will be sent to {{model}}, the model named in Settings. Nothing else is sent: no birthday, no profile, no test answers.
journal.consentBody_other: The words of {{count}} written days (title, date and the first 300 characters of each entry) will be sent to {{model}}, the model named in Settings. Nothing else is sent: no birthday, no profile, no test answers.

errors.not_configured: Connect an AI in Settings first.
errors.rate_limited: You have reached today's limit of AI calls. Try again tomorrow.
errors.provider_rejected: Your AI provider turned the request down.
errors.provider_empty: Your AI provider sent back nothing.
errors.provider_unreachable: Could not reach your AI provider.
errors.provider_invalid: The AI answered in a form that could not be used. Try again.
errors.generic: Could not read your journal. Try again.
